title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

26-30k

Looking for your next step within HR?

This could be a great opportunity to step into a varied position where you'll work with businesses across a range of industries, helping them stay compliant and up to date with their HR documentation.

We're looking for someone with practical HR knowledge, strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with clients.

Day to Day
- Understanding each client's business, challenges and HR requirements.
- Advising clients on HR documentation and employment-related queries.
- Drafting bespoke HR documentation, including contracts, policies and handbooks.
- Keeping up to date with changes in employment legislation and best practice.
- Managing your own workload to meet agreed KPIs, SLAs and deadlines.
- Building strong, long-term relationships with clients through every interaction.
- Supporting existing clients with ongoing HR queries and documentation.
- Identifying opportunities to introduce relevant HR products and services.

YOU?
- Practical HR experience and a basic understanding of employment legislation.
- Someone confident communicating with clients and building rapport quickly.
- Strong written skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach.
- The ability to research and interpret HR legislation quickly.

This is a role where you'll be trusted to take ownership, work directly with clients and develop your HR knowledge from day one.

You'll receive ongoing training and development, regular employment law updates and a clear career pathway as you progress.

If you're looking for a role where you can combine HR knowledge, client interaction and problem-solving, this could be the next step for you.

title: Level 3 Teaching Assistant
description:
Job Title: Level 3 Teaching Assistant
Location: Loughborough, Leicestershire
Pay Rate: 105 per day
Working Pattern: Monday to Friday, 5 days per week
Contract: Full-time, based in one primary school
HELP SHAPE YOUNG MINDS - LEVEL 3 TEACHING ASSISTANT
Aspire People are delighted to be partnering with a primary school in Loughborough to find a dedicated Level 3 Teaching Assistant who is ready to make a real difference in the classroom.
We are looking for an enthusiastic and committed individual who understands the importance of creating a supportive learning environment where children feel confident, motivated and ready to succeed.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Teaching Assistant who wants to become a valued member of a school team, build meaningful relationships with pupils and contribute to their educational progress.
With a competitive rate of 105 per day and a consistent Monday-to-Friday schedule, this role is ideal for someone looking for a full-time position within one school.
YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Working alongside the teaching team, you will play an important part in supporting pupils throughout their school day.
Your responsibilities will include:
Assisting teachers with lesson delivery and classroom activities.
Providing targeted support to individuals and small groups of pupils.
Helping children overcome learning barriers and develop their confidence.
Supporting pupils with additional needs and adapting activities where appropriate.
Encouraging positive behaviour and engagement with learning.
Preparing resources and helping create an organised, stimulating classroom.
Observing pupil development and communicating progress to the class teacher.
Promoting inclusion, independence and positive relationships throughout the school.
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE
We want to hear from Teaching Assistants who are passionate about education and committed to helping children achieve their best.
To be considered, you must have:
A recognised Level 3 Teaching Assistant qualification.
Previous experience working in a UK school setting.
A genuine interest in supporting children's academic and personal development.
The ability to work collaboratively with teachers and other support staff.
Strong communication, organisation and interpersonal skills.
A dependable and flexible approach to the school day.
An understanding of safeguarding and child protection responsibilities.
WHY APPLY THROUGH ASPIRE PEOPLE?
At Aspire People, we work closely with schools to connect talented education professionals with opportunities where they can thrive.
By applying for this position, you'll have the opportunity to:
Earn 105 per day in a full-time role.
Work five days a week, Monday to Friday.
Become part of one primary school's team.
Build consistent relationships with pupils and colleagues.
Make a meaningful contribution to children's learning and development.
Receive support from Aspire People throughout the recruitment process and placement.
SAFEGUARDING
Aspire People and our partner school are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. The successful applicant will be required to complete the relevant pre-employment checks, including an enhanced DBS check where applicable, in accordance with safeguarding and safer recruitment requirements.
READY FOR YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY?
If you hold a Level 3 Teaching Assistant qualification, have experience working in UK schools and are looking for your next role in Loughborough, we'd love to hear from you.
Get in touch today to find out more about this opportunity.
Contact: Matt - Aspire People
Email:
Make your next career move with Aspire People!
Aspire People Limited provides services as an Education Agency and an Education Employment Business. Aspire People is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of pupils and expects every candidate to share this commitment. Placements are subject, to appropriate Child Protection screening, including checks with former employers and the Disclosure and Barring Checks.

title: Part-time HR Coordinator
description:
Part-Time HR Coordinator

Castle Donington

Approx. 22 Hours Per Week (3 days) - Primarily site-based with 1 day home working, and flexible working days

Are you an organised HR professional with exceptional IT skills? Do you enjoy improving processes, managing digital systems and using technology to create efficient ways of working?

We are seeking a Part-Time HR Coordinator to join a successful and growing business based in Castle Donington. Working approximately 22 hours across 3 days per week, this role offers flexibility around which days you work, making it ideal for those seeking a better work-life balance.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who combines strong HR administration experience with a high level of IT proficiency. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining HR systems, developing digital resources, supporting onboarding processes and helping to drive improvements across HR administration and employee communications.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the full administration process for new starters, leavers and employee changes
- Coordinating onboarding activities and preparing employment documentation
- Maintaining accurate HR records and employee data across HR systems
- Creating, developing and managing HR content within SharePoint and other digital platforms
- Supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems
- Producing HR reports, metrics and management information
- Managing employee communications, policies and HR documentation
- Supporting health & safety administration and compliance activities
- Providing general HR support to employees and managers

About You

This role will suit someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented and particularly comfortable working with technology.

Essential requirements:
- Previous experience in an HR Administration, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator position
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook
- Excellent IT literacy and confidence working with HR systems and databases
- Experience creating, updating and maintaining SharePoint sites, intranet content or digital employee resources
- Comfortable learning new software and introducing more efficient ways of working
- Experience managing onboarding documentation and employee records electronically
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion

What's on Offer?
- Part-time hours - approximately 22 hours per week
- 3 days per week with flexibility on working days
- Hybrid working with up to 1 day per week from home
- Varied and interesting HR role with broad responsibility
- Opportunity to make a real impact through process and system improvements
- Friendly and supportive working environment

This role is ideal for a HR professional who enjoys both the people and systems side of HR. If you're highly IT literate, enjoy building digital solutions such as SharePoint resources, and take pride in creating efficient HR processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Should you require any support or assistance, please contact your local Gi Group office.

Gi Group Holdings Recruitment Limited are proud founding members of Menopause in business, corporate members for Neurodiversity in business, Disability Confident committed members, Gold status for the Armed Forces Covenant, Bronze trail blazers for Racial Equality matters and Age Friendly Employer pledge members.

title: People Assistant
description:
The Opportunity

Superbia Group is a wealth management and financial planning group, with offices based across the UK and Chennai, India. With an ambitious growth plan, we are entering the most exciting phase of our journey, scaling across new areas of the business and building the team that will define our growth.

This HR/People Assistant will be at the heart of how our people experience Superbia. Not as someone who simply processes paperwork, and not as someone who waits to be told what to do, but as a proactive, people-focused member of our People and Internal Communications team who makes sure every colleague is supported from their first day to their last.

You'll start by owning the day-to-day HR administration across the employee lifecycle, keeping our people systems accurate, coordinating recruitment and onboarding, and supporting our Senior Leadership Team. As we grow, so will the role.

We are looking for someone humble enough to get into the detail, and driven enough to make a real difference to how our people feel about working here.

Why Superbia

Our culture is our edge. We are ambitious without being arrogant. We move fast without cutting corners. We hold ourselves and each other to high standards - and we look after our people. The right HR Assistant will feel that from day one and will choose to add to it.

The HR Assistant who joins now will have a real hand in shaping how we attract, welcome and support our people along the way.

Here is what you are joining:
- A business performing strongly and growing fast with a clear, ambitious plan and the backing to deliver it.
- A role that will grow with the business you'll start by owning our core People administration & supporting our senior leadership team and expand your remit as we scale, with real opportunities to learn and develop your HR career, including support towards a CIPD qualifications.
- B Corp certified, purpose-driven culture values are not a poster on the wall. They are how decisions get made and how people are treated.

The HR Assistant who joins now arrives at the moment that matters, with the chance to help solidify the people foundations that will support our growth.

Role Overview

What you'll do:
- Act as the first point of contact for people queries from colleagues and managers, and Senior Leadership giving clear, accurate and timely support.
- Manage HR administration across the full employee lifecycle, including offer letters, contracts, contractual changes, probation reviews and leavers.
- Coordinate recruitment activity, including posting adverts, liaising with candidates and hiring managers, and supporting our structured selection approach.
- Deliver a smooth, welcoming onboarding experience for new starters, including pre-employment checks, induction scheduling and pairing new starters with a buddy.
- Keep our people records accurate and up to date in our ZOHO people systems
- Coordinate business travel to and from our Chennai office, including bookings, itineraries and supporting documentation.
- Support our health and safety responsibilities, including keeping records, assessments and training up to date.
- Help organise our quarterly staff events
- Handle confidential information with discretion and in line with GDPR.
- Spot and act on opportunities to improve our people processes as we grow.

Who We Are Looking For

Experience & Qualifications:
- Experience in an HR processes, such as recruitment, onboarding and employment lifecycle
- Experience in supporting senior leadership, co-ordinating diaries
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and deadlines at once.
- High attention to detail and a commitment to keeping records accurate.
- Confidence using HR systems
- Strong communication skills, approachable and the confident working with colleagues at all levels.
- Discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential information.
- A proactive, solution-focused approach and a willingness to roll up your sleeves.
- Comfortable working with colleagues across different countries and time zones.
- Desirable: CIPD Level 3 (or working towards it), or a genuine interest in building a career in HR.
- Desirable: experience of HR in financial services or a regulated environment.

title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Ideal recruit are looking for a Recruitment Resourcer to join our growing Industrial team in Leicester, supporting our clients and their operations.

This is a great opportunity to become part of a supportive team where you ll play a key role in helping clients find the right people for their warehouse operations.

What you ll be doing:
- Working closely with management to understand recruitment needs and client requirements
- Supporting our clients by delivering a high-quality recruitment service
- Sourcing candidates using a range of tools (CV databases, job boards, open days, etc.)
- Managing the full recruitment process, from initial contact through to onboarding
- Registering new candidates and ensuring all compliance is up to date
- Supporting the team with general recruitment administration

What we re looking for:
- A motivated and reliable individual with a positive attitude
- Someone proactive, organised, and responsive
- Ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- Willingness to learn and grow within a developing company

What we offer:
- Full-time
- Salary £25.842 - depending on experience
- Monday to Friday, 09 00
- Full training and resources provided to support your development

Requirements:
- Previous recruitment experience is desirable (minimum 6 months), but not essential
- Driving licence is required

If this sounds like a role for you, please apply with your up-to-date CV - we d love to hear from you!
